channel.title: Food Recall Digest
channel.description: Daily audited US food recall summaries

item.title: Thu, Oct 1, 2026: Walmart frozen fettuccine recalled for Listeria
item.description: Walmart bettergoods Lemon Alfredo Fettuccine recalled (all lots) for Listeria. Alfalfa sprout outbreak grows to 76 sick. 2 more stores named for the guanciale recall.

item.title: Wed, Sep 30, 2026: 3 high-risk recalls you should check for
item.description: 3 high-risk recalls: Graziers raw milk cheese (13 sick), Berlin Seeds alfalfa seed, Niwali tejocote. Plus 53 named stores for a USDA meat recall.
